method: Read-only local archive/source/JSON inspection, complete FP32 matrix restoration and dot/rank recomputation; no server, model or codec execution by this review.

originals.name: png-candidate-i-originals.tar.gz
originals.member_recovery: Exact member names/bytes/SHA256 are recorded in png_candidate.json originals.members; run members include output/result.json, output/rm-vectors.npz and index/index, index/vecs.

numerical.text_scope: Replacement text runs on CPU; stock gold uses CUDA. Local dot recomputation uses a different NumPy version from the recorded runtime.

hse.scope: Broker blocks only; the RM full PNG list and serialization copies are outside this capacity.

nonblocking_correction.excluded_field: Lease-present Boolean used an incorrect basename.
nonblocking_correction.scope: The correction is a later snapshot, not a reconstruction of the earlier check. Both records are preserved; per-call physical exits and successful owner lease.release remain the primary cleanup evidence.

preserved_failures: G manifest-digest AssertionError with zero cases
G2 TimeoutError during the final second default case
preceding_cpu_diagnostic.scope: Incomplete second round; no partial final-case measurements or raw PNG/RGB controls are available for offline pixel re-verification.

scope_limits: Only Direct/HSE PNG default versus level1 candidate qualified here; defaults/protocol and prior six-arm results remain unchanged, and the candidate is not adopted.
Six cells with one occurrence each cannot establish a performance ranking, steady state or reliable P99/P99.99.
PNG encoding wall and process CPU intervals are measured; process CPU is not a main-thread-only codec timer.
Preprocess combines RGB decode, resize and normalization. Actor service and host-copy telemetry are aggregate existing intervals; HSE submit time is host submission, not transport.
Pure decode, transport, H2D/kernel/D2H subphase durations are unavailable. No prior JCT subtraction, PG or VLM map/filter claim.
Other candidate backends and end-to-end adoption remain unverified.
